text: Security is an essential part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between the user and the server. Authentication helps confirm that users are who they say they are, usually through strong passwords or extra steps like two-factor verification. Developers must also validate all input, because unchecked data can open the door to attacks. Common vulnerabilities include SQL injection, cross-site scripting, and weak passwords. By following basic security rules, developers can reduce risks and keep users safe.
